fusions.name: Ripple Pings
fusions.desc: Looses 4 sonic pings in a spread, each dealing 3 resonating damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds. 15% of the damage dealt comes back as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Undertow
fusions.desc: Strikes the target, dealing 12 water damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and knocking it back 2 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Slipstream
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds, with 20% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Flicker Dance
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (14% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
